title: Chipotle Rewards on Repeat: Free Chips & Guac Welcome Gift
description: Join the relaunched 2026 Chipotle 'Rewards on Repeat' program and receive a complimentary order of freshly made tortilla chips and hand-mashed guacamole ($4.95+ value) with your first qualifying $5+ purchase.
sf_details: Confirmed active for all 8 San Francisco branches (Financial District, SoMa Metreon, Sunset Stonestown, Lakeshore, Richmond Geary, and East Cut). Simply create a new Chipotle Rewards account.
beginner_guide:
1. Download the official Chipotle App (iOS/Android) or visit chipotle.com/rewards.
2. Create a free Chipotle Rewards account with your email.
3. The 'Free Chips & Guac' welcome reward is automatically added to your Rewards Wallet.
4. Build an order with any entrée (burrito, bowl, or quesadilla) totaling at least $5.00.
5. Add 'Chips & Guacamole' to your bag and tap 'Apply Reward' at checkout to drop the chips & guac price to $0.00!

title: Summer of Extras 2026: Free Entrée Monthly Streak Challenge
description: Chipotle's official Summer of Extras 2026 is live for August! Opt-in through the app or website. Complete a 7-entrée purchase streak this month to receive a 100% Free Entrée Reward (or 1,625 bonus points).
sf_details: Valid for all Chipotle Rewards members ordering from any of the 8 San Francisco locations. Every entrée purchase of $10+ counts toward your 7-visit August milestone.
beginner_guide:
1. Open the Chipotle App and tap the 'Rewards' tab.
2. Locate the 'Summer of Extras 2026' banner and tap 'Opt In'.
3. Order your favorite meals throughout August (burritos, bowls, or salads).
4. Track your streak progress in the app. Upon your 7th purchase, your Free Entrée reward is delivered directly to your wallet!

title: Chipotle U: 1,000 Bonus Points + 20% Faster Rewards for Students
description: Enrolled college students get an immediate 1,000 bonus points ($8 value, getting you over halfway to a free meal!) upon ID.me verification, plus earn 12 points per $1 spent (20% faster than regular members) and access exclusive student BOGOs.
sf_details: Available for all students attending San Francisco universities & colleges (SF State, USF, UCSF, CCSF, Academy of Art, etc.) ordering at any SF store.
beginner_guide:
1. Open your profile in the Chipotle App or visit chipotle.com/rewards.
2. Tap 'Join Chipotle U Rewards'.
3. Complete the quick 1-minute verification via ID.me using your student .edu email or student ID card.
4. Instantly receive 1,000 welcome points and automatically earn 12 pts/$1 on all future SF orders!

title: Chipotle x 2XKO Tag Team Event: Promo Drop & Food Rewards
description: Enter code TAGTEAM at digital checkout to receive the exclusive in-game Chipotle Fresh Fit Bundle in Riot Games' 2XKO and unlock chances to earn Free Dips (Guac/Queso), Chips & Dip, or Buy-One-Get-One (BOGO) Free Entrée coupons!
savings: Exclusive In-Game Bundle + Free Food Drops
sf_details: Confirmed active for all 8 San Francisco locations (including Sutter St, 50 California St, and Metreon). Applicable only on the official Chipotle App or Chipotle.com. Limited to 40,000 uses nationwide.
beginner_guide:
1. Open the Chipotle App or Chipotle.com.
2. Set your store location to any of the 8 SF branches (e.g., 50 California St or Metreon).
3. Add a regular-priced entrée item to your bag.
4. Go to checkout, expand 'Promo Code', enter 'TAGTEAM', and tap apply.
5. You will receive your digital redemption code for in-game items and entry for food rewards!

title: Chipotle Honey Chicken Protein + $0 Delivery Fee
description: Chipotle's sweet and spicy ('swicy') Chipotle Honey Chicken is featured on the menu! Order any entrée featuring Honey Chicken through the official app or website and receive a $0 delivery fee.
sf_details: Available across all San Francisco delivery zones. The standard baseline delivery fee is reduced to $0. Note: Local San Francisco health/mandate ordinances and standard service fees still apply.
beginner_guide:
1. Go to Chipotle's online menu or app and select 'Delivery'.
2. Enter your San Francisco delivery address.
3. Build your bowl, burrito, quesadilla, or salad and choose 'Chipotle Honey Chicken' as your protein.
4. The $0 delivery fee will automatically apply at checkout without requiring a coupon code.

title: 50% Off Chipotle Orders on DoorDash
description: Get a huge 50% discount on your Chipotle order when checking out on DoorDash using the special promo code. Perfect for a quick, cheap meal delivered straight to your door in San Francisco.
sf_details: Valid for DoorDash deliveries originating from participating San Francisco Chipotle locations. This promo is active through August 8, 2026. Limit one use per account.
beginner_guide:
1. Open the DoorDash App or website.
2. Search for 'Chipotle' and select the nearest SF location (e.g., Metreon or Geary Blvd).
3. Add your favorite items to your cart.
4. Proceed to checkout, paste 'DDCHIP50' in the promo code field, and enjoy 50% off!

title: $10 Off Your First Digital Order ($15+ Min)
description: Create a new Chipotle Rewards account and receive a $10 discount on your first digital order of $15 or more. An exceptional way for beginners to try Chipotle's digital pickup or delivery.
sf_details: Valid for new digital accounts at all 8 San Francisco branches. Orders must be placed via the Chipotle App or Chipotle.com for pickup or delivery.
beginner_guide:
1. Download the Chipotle App or go to Chipotle.com.
2. Register a new account with your email.
3. Add at least $15 of food to your cart (e.g., one burrito bowl and chips & guac).
4. In the checkout screen, enter 'TRY10' in the promo code section to subtract $10.

title: Chipotle Receipt Survey: Free Burritos For A Year Sweepstakes
description: Turn your SF restaurant receipt into free food! Complete the 2-minute Chipotle Customer Satisfaction Survey using the 20-digit code on your receipt to enter to win 52 Free Burrito Cards ($520+ annual value).
sf_details: Applicable on receipts from all 8 San Francisco brick-and-mortar stores. Survey must be completed within 7 days of your restaurant purchase.
beginner_guide:
1. Save your paper receipt when ordering at any SF Chipotle location.
2. Head to www.chipotlefeedback.com on your phone or laptop.
3. Enter the 20-digit receipt survey code found near the bottom of your ticket.
4. Complete the brief 2-minute survey to enter the monthly sweepstakes for 52 free meals!

title: 80¢ Boneless Wings (Mondays & Tuesdays SF Special)
description: Get delicious, crispy, sauced-and-tossed boneless wings for only 80 cents each (adjusted for SF local operating costs from the national 70¢ rate) every Monday and Tuesday! No promo code required.
savings: ~40% Off regular a la carte wings
sf_details: Verified active at all 4 SF locations (1200 Market St, 60 Morris St SoMa, 90 Charter Oak Ave Bayview, and 1507 Sloat Blvd Lakeshore). Available for carryout, dine-in, or digital ordering in 10, 15, or 20-count sizes.
beginner_guide:
1. Order on a Monday or Tuesday via Wingstop.com, the Wingstop App, or in-person.
2. Choose any of the 4 SF locations.
3. Go to 'Wings' and select 'Boneless Wings' in a count of 10, 15, or 20.
4. Pick your favorite flavors (e.g. Lemon Pepper, Garlic Parmesan, Spicy Korean Q, or Mango Habanero).
5. Check your cart subtotal: the wings automatically discount to 80¢ each without needing a coupon code!

title: The Wingstop Club: Free Seasoned Hand-Cut Fries Sign-Up & Birthday Gift
description: Join Wingstop's official loyalty program 'The Club' to receive an immediate email voucher for a Free Regular Order of Fresh-Cut Seasoned Fries ($4.29 value), plus an annual Free Birthday Food Gift.
sf_details: Valid at all 4 San Francisco Wingstop stores. The welcome voucher is delivered directly to your inbox within minutes of signing up.
beginner_guide:
1. Visit wingstop.com/the-club or open the Wingstop App and tap 'The Club'.
2. Enter your name, email, favorite SF location, and birthday.
3. Open your confirmation email to find your unique Free Fries promo voucher.
4. Add a Regular Seasoned Fries to your online order and enter the voucher code at checkout to make it 100% free!

title: 20% Off Your Entire Wingstop Order ($15+ Min)
description: Save an extra 20% on your entire order at Wingstop when you spend $15 or more. Works across all wings, crispy tenders, hand-cut fries, dips, and drinks.
sf_details: Valid at all 4 San Francisco locations for digital carryout or delivery orders placed via Wingstop.com or the official Wingstop App. Requires a minimum pre-tax subtotal of $15.
beginner_guide:
1. Open Wingstop.com or the Wingstop App.
2. Set your store to the nearest SF location (e.g., 1200 Market St or 60 Morris St).
3. Add at least $15 of wings, fries, and scratch-made ranch to your order.
4. In the checkout screen, locate the 'Promo Code' box, enter 'WING2026', and click apply.

title: $16.99 Boneless Meal Deal (Feeds 3-4 People)
description: Get a crowd-pleasing feast including 20 Crispy Boneless Wings (customizable with up to 4 different flavors), a Large Order of Fresh-Cut Seasoned Fries, and 2 Scratch-Made Dips (like Wingstop's famous Ranch) for just $16.99!
sf_details: Available for carryout or delivery across all 4 SF locations. Feeds 3-4 hungry eaters at under $4.25 per person.
beginner_guide:
1. Visit Wingstop.com or open the app and choose your nearest SF restaurant.
2. Go to the 'Deals & Combos' menu category.
3. Click 'Boneless Meal Deal ($16.99)'.
4. Select your 20 boneless wings and choose up to 4 flavors (e.g., Lemon Pepper, Garlic Parmesan, Spicy Korean Q, Louisiana Rub).
5. Pick 2 homemade dips (Ranch, Bleu Cheese, or Honey Mustard) and add to cart!

title: $19.99 All-In Bundle (Wings + Tenders + Fries + 3 Dips)
description: Massive value bundle: 16-Piece Boneless or Bone-In Wings (up to 4 flavors), 6-Piece Crispy Tenders, Large Seasoned Fries, and 3 Scratch-Made Dips (like Wingstop's famous homemade Ranch) for $19.99!
sf_details: Available for carryout or delivery at all 4 San Francisco locations. Note: SF local pricing shows as $21.99 due to regional CA wage adjustments, which is still a phenomenal 35% savings over ordering items individually.
beginner_guide:
1. Go to Wingstop.com or the app.
2. Choose any SF location for carryout or delivery.
3. Go to the 'Deals' or 'Combos' tab on the menu.
4. Click on the 'All-In Bundle'.
5. Select your wing style, customize up to 4 delicious flavors, choose your dips, and add to bag. The discount is built-in!

title: 5 Free Boneless Wings with Wednesday Wing Combo
description: Order any regular wing combo on a Wednesday and receive 5 completely free boneless wings added to your order with this active digital promo coupon code.
sf_details: Valid on Wednesdays only at all 4 SF locations. Requires purchase of a regular wing combo meal (wings, fries, and a drink).
beginner_guide:
1. Open Wingstop.com or the app on a Wednesday.
2. Set your store to any of the 4 SF locations.
3. Add any standard Wing Combo (including wings, fries, and a drink) to your cart.
4. Add a 5-piece a la carte Boneless Wings order to your cart.
5. Apply promo code 'R5BW' at checkout to make the 5 boneless wings $0.00!

title: Free Regular Hand-Cut Fries on Orders $20+
description: Get a free order of Wingstop's freshly cut, seasoned regular fries (a $4.29 value) when you place an order of $20 or more and apply the active coupon code.
sf_details: Verified at all 4 SF Wingstop stores. The cart subtotal must be at least $20 before adding the fries. Valid for online carryout and delivery orders.
beginner_guide:
1. Order online on the Wingstop website or app for SF pickup.
2. Build an order worth $20 or more (e.g., a 15-piece wing group pack or 2 combos).
3. Add a 'Regular Fries' to your cart.
4. Go to checkout, type in 'IES' in the promo code box, and apply it. Your fries will show as $0.00!

title: Wingstop Guest Survey: Free Seasoned Fries or $5 Off Coupon
description: Take 2 minutes to fill out the guest survey at tellwingstop.com using the invitation code on your receipt to receive a coupon code for Free Regular Seasoned Fries or $5 off your next visit.
savings: Free Seasoned Fries or $5.00 Off Next Visit
sf_details: Valid at all 4 San Francisco Wingstop locations. Receipts contain a survey code valid for 3 days after ordering.
beginner_guide:
1. Save the receipt from your visit to any SF Wingstop restaurant.
2. Visit www.tellwingstop.com within 3 days of purchase.
3. Input the store number, date, and order ticket number printed on your receipt.
4. Answer the short customer survey. At the end, you'll receive a validation code to write on your receipt for Free Fries or $5 off next time!
